_about: Simulator settings for the MedFlow history. Products, packaging, bins, zones, warehouses and hospitals are READ from the database (scripts/sim/db.py lists the table rules); this file says how they behave. Everything here is copied into ground_truth.json with the data.
_end_date: null = the day before the run; or an ISO date
_profiles: the simulator uses EXACTLY the first n_products ids, MED0001 .. MED{n}
_subsidiaries: demand_multiplier = the subsidiary's share of network demand relative to the average subsidiary (they sum to 5.25 over five). Hospitals are the subsidiary's existing site rows; 'hospitals' is used only for a warehouse that has none.

demand._source: product.manualbasedemand = annual NETWORK demand in dosage units (static). Hospitals request SALES PACKS (storage.salespackqty dosage units each). Network packs/day = manualbasedemand / 365 / salespackqty; a subsidiary gets that x its multiplier / 5.25.
demand._packs_per_line: mean sales packs on one hospital request line, by product.velocityclass; drawn log-uniform per product. Lines per day = packs per day / packs per line.
demand._line_cv: variability of the quantity on one request line
demand._request_regularity: how many requests include a product each day is drawn as if several requesting wards each ask with probability at most this value: busy products are asked for steadily, slow ones sporadically
demand._multiplier_split: a subsidiary's multiplier is applied as multiplier^x to the number of request lines and multiplier^(1-x) to the quantity per line
demand._hour_weights: relative request volume per hour of the day, 00:00 .. 23:00: peak 09:00-18:00, little to none 01:00-05:00

bundles._what: products that land on the same hospital request together: the ground truth for UC1. Each bundle appears on a share of a subsidiary's requests (support_target), with each member present with probability p_include. UC1 gates: support >= 0.02, confidence >= 0.50, lift >= 1.20.
bundles._bands: how UC1's rules are graded; the planted bands are designed to land here. Weak = passes the three gates only.

list.name: Cold and flu
list.why: symptomatic treatment: antihistamine (Piriton), decongestant spray (Otrivin), antipyretic (Panadol)

list.name: H. pylori triple therapy
list.why: clarithromycin (Klacid) + amoxicillin (Amoxil) + omeprazole (Losec): the standard eradication regimen

list.name: Asthma exacerbation
list.why: preventer inhaler (Pulmicort), reliever inhaler (Ventolin), short steroid course (prednisolone)

list.name: Hypertension
list.why: thiazide (HCTZ) with amlodipine (Norvasc) and losartan (Cozaar): common combination therapy

list.name: Conjunctivitis
list.why: chloramphenicol eye drops with a lubricant (Isopto Tears); planted below the support gate on purpose

list.name: Otitis externa
list.why: ofloxacin ear drops with oral amoxicillin-clavulanate (Augmentin); planted below the support gate on purpose

bundles._confidence_target: the anchor -> member confidence each band aims for; 'below' bundles get no anchor and fail the gates on confidence and support

baseline_policy._what: what the subsidiaries did BEFORE UC2 (the history). Daily review against their own reorder point and order-up-to level, in sales packs, but mis-sized and with timing slips: the inefficiency UC2 removes. Written to warehouseproduct.
baseline_policy._error_sigma: each subsidiary x product's ROP and OUL carry a fixed error drawn once: log-normal with this sigma (0.35 = two thirds of SKUs within +-35%)
baseline_policy._qty_noise: each order quantity varies uniformly by +- this fraction before cartonising
baseline_policy._timing: early: on a day the position is within early_band above the ROP, order anyway with early_prob. late: with late_prob, skip the first day a product reaches its ROP.

_carton_rule: Central -> subsidiary orders are whole cartons (storage.shippingcasepack sales packs): the number of cartons nearest to the gap up to the order-up-to level, never fewer than it takes to lift the position above the reorder point, at least one.

central._what: WH001 keeps a MAX stock per product in whole cartons: cover_days of mean dispatch to the subsidiaries plus safety stock at service_level_z on the daily dispatch. After each evening's dispatch every shipped product is topped back up to its max by the supplier (instant). Bins are sized to the max.
central._zone_by_class: starting layout: the zone each velocity class is placed in; bins filled in id order (aisle, rack, level, face, bin)
central._opening_received_days_ago: datereceived of the opening bin stock, days before the first day

times._what: clock times of the daily cycle (local time)
